newsitem.title: USA: Ascent Entertainment to buy Spectravision.
newsitem.headline: Ascent Entertainment to buy Spectravision.

text.p: Ascent Entertainment Group Inc said Friday the United States Bankruptcy Court for the district of Delaware had confirmed the bankruptcy reorganization plan of Spectravision Inc.

According to the plan, Ascent said it would, in a cashless transaction, combine its subsidiary, On Command Video Corp, with the assets and certain liabilities of Spectravision, forming a new corporation to be called On Command Corp.
On Command Corp will be publicly traded and has made an application to trade on the Nasdaq stock market, Ascent said.
Ascent said it will continue to be the majority shareholder of On Command Corp.
